source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: KH Coder is a Perl/Tk text analysis application: kh_coder.pl opens the main window that loads a project, splits the text with kh_morpho.pm and stores the words in MySQL. Coding goes through kh_cod.pm and graphics through the bridge to R. The repository states that this code is an old beta version.
